title: TikTok Hot Honey Halloumi
description: This viral TikTok hot honey halloumi appetizer is super easy, making it a perfect addition to your next party buffet or cheese board.
ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon fresh thyme leaves, plus more for garnish
1 tablespoon neutral-flavored oil, such as grapeseed or canola

steps.text: Slice halloumi into 6 to 8 even pieces.
Combine honey, lemon juice, red pepper flakes, thyme leaves, and salt in a shallow bowl. Add halloumi slices and turn to coat each side. Allow to marinate in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully place the cheese slices in the skillet and sear for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, checking regularly to make sure it doesn't burn.
Once the halloumi has reached a golden brown color, move to a serving plate. Top with leftover marinade and garnish with additional thyme leaves. Serve with crackers or pita bread.

video.description: FoodTok has been obsessed with this Hot Honey Halloumi recipe, so we put the popular TikTok trend to the test. Its simple marinade–featuring honey and red pepper flakes–pairs perfectly with the salty cheese and gets a nice caramelized crust when seared. (ICYMI: Halloumi cheese has a high melting point, so it doesn’t get unwieldy when cooked.) This sweet-and-salty appetizer is simply divine and makes the perfect addition to your summer charcuterie board.
